name: [🫧UPD] Dont Wake Up DIO
desc:
Shh... Don't Wake Up DIO! 🤫

Sneak around and steal Bizarre while they sleep! 😴
Escape when you wake them up and they start chasing! 🏃‍♂️
Survive and collect as many Bizarre as possible! ⚡

If you're having fun, remember to hit the like button! 👍

Tags : Jojo, Dio, Jojo Bizarre Adventure, Jonathan.
